title: An appointment in a skipped or repeated hour
summary: Toronto's missing spring hour has no valid offset. Its repeated autumn hour admits two ordered offsets.

change.description: Toronto's missing spring hour has no valid offset. Its repeated autumn hour admits two ordered offsets.

notes: Canada's rules since 2007 select the second March Sunday at 02:00 for the one-hour advance and the first November Sunday at 02:00 for its reversal. Toronto's standard offset is UTC−05. The resulting twelve zone/local-time entries are each run with two different process defaults. Source consulted 2026-11-20: https://github.com/eggert/tz/blob/2024a/northamerica.
